details.explanation: For Task C I replaced the O(n^2) nested-loop duplicate detector with a linear pass using collections.Counter to compute frequencies and return words with count > 1. This reduces complexity from O(n^2) to O(n) and yields a measurable improvement on the provided large input. Baseline (before this change) for the large file was 0.00282s; after the change it was 0.000702s (about a 4x improvement in this environment). I considered keeping the nested loop but adding caching; replacing the algorithm is the simplest, most robust fix with minimal code changes and no change to the function API.
